A '''cantina band''' was popular during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but were kidnapped by the [[Kanawyn Syndicate]] during a tour of the [[Cha Raaba system]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Investigation|Sour Note}}</ref>
